scope_note: Selected ADR review only, not whole-ADR certification. This shard uses the current source and tests; earlier action refusal histories and open-order/action-chain test families are not reopened.

decisions.review: §12.4.4.2 NOTE 3 limits the need to respect navigation nodes to presentation mode. Command::Present is the host condition, and the current presentation state machine implements primary-node arrival, next/previous state, and page turn. The related newer random-access arrival assertion checks the primary NA and exposes selected Next through the later PA request.
decisions.disposition: Retain the mode gate and state-machine interpretation. The audit did not duplicate the existing arrival test. Explicit no-recovery assertion is a small fixture-evidence gap, not an observed behavior failure.

decisions.topic: Sub-page clock and arrow key host mappings
decisions.review: Current tests verify node Dur/no-Dur via injected Tick, OCG restore at presentation exit, and key behavior through Command::GoTo. These are consistent with the current host clock and key mapping; no stale old clock/page-transition premise found in the sampled paths.
decisions.disposition: Retain. Timing comparison is a current reader choice at the stated maximum, not a numerical display cadence requirement.

decisions.topic: Annotation state reader and its consumer boundary
decisions.review: ADR 1051's page-local reply-chain model remains consistent for conforming inputs. ADR 1784 corrects the obsolete host-caller claim: annotation_state::states currently has no non-test caller. §12.5.6.3 has no UI/rendering SHALL; §12.5.6.2 separately requires replies shown together as threaded comments. Table175 makes /StateModel mandatory when /State appears, and T specifies the author, so missing-field inference/anonymous-user grouping are recovery policy rather than valid-input obligations.
decisions.disposition: Keep the state parser/API and no-UI-obligation conclusion. Retain exact-xref regression for valid reply chains; new draft covers only valid StateModel-only defaults. Do not certify the broader §12.5.6.2 threaded-comment UI from this row.

decisions.topic: GoToDp makes DPart hierarchy relevant to view navigation
decisions.review: ADR 0108's decision to perform GoToDp based on its page-selecting sentence remains current. Later DPart root corrections (#609/#614) are reflected in document_part.rs; ADR 1040 explains a separate DPart-associated-file path, while ADR 0475 identifies the earlier status-row reach issue. Current code resolves an interior node to its first depth-first leaf page.
decisions.disposition: Retain action support. Add a viewer public assertion for action-to-page behavior before claiming end-to-end route evidence; no mandatory DPart panel is inferred here.

decisions.topic: Thread navigation, article order, and remote file request
decisions.review: The selected thread UI remains an optional §12.4.3 navigation facility. #320 and ADR 0746 make the article bead order reading order. ADR 1239's external-file request route remains current. Public local route tests first bead/FitR; remote route opens supplied file at bead page; model assertions cover D/B encodings and duplicate-title tie-break.
decisions.disposition: Retain. Add the drafted local `/D 0 /B 1` public route to close the gap between model parsing and the actual viewer consumer, without requiring a next-bead UI control.

decisions.topic: Transition action independent of presentation and chosen visual quantities
decisions.review: §12.6.4.15 itself lacks the page-transition clause's presentation-mode condition, supporting ADR 1216's action behavior. ADR 1299's A72-selected style quantities remain implementation choices, not standards pixel counts. Clock tests support host timing, but current public event tests exercise page /Trans rather than Action::Trans.
decisions.disposition: Keep the action outside presentation-mode gating and retain reported quantities. Add the draft public Viewer action test to prove the link-triggered Action::Trans reaches Event::Transition.
